howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 就多了一个 WhatsApp 入口，用户可以通过 WhatsApp 私聊它。它需要你按步骤在 Meta 后台填好凭据，之后消息就会通过官方 WhatsApp Cloud API 收发。
howto.when: 当你在 NanoClaw 中运行 `/setup` 流程或 `/manage-channels` 命令，并选择接入 WhatsApp 渠道时，这个技能就会被调用。需要先完成 Meta 后台的应用和凭据配置。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude gets a WhatsApp entry point: people can chat with it 1:1 over WhatsApp. You complete the Meta dashboard setup as instructed, then messages flow through the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
howto.when_en: This skill is used when you run the `/setup` flow or the `/manage-channels` command in NanoClaw to add a WhatsApp channel. Meta dashboard setup must already be done.

say_en.text: Help me connect WhatsApp using add-whatsapp-cloud

say_en.text: Run tests to verify the WhatsApp channel is registered
say_en.note: Runs vitest to check the registration.

say_en.text: Wire the WhatsApp channel to my agent group
